name: devops-sre-ops
description: Use when defining or reviewing reliability targets and operations practice - SLI/SLO/SLA and error budgets (and the error budget policy), multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts, incident response (roles, severity, mitigate first, handoff), on-call rotation and toil, blameless postmortems, change management and safe rollout (canary, freeze, rollback criteria decided in advance), runbooks, capacity planning, production readiness reviews, DORA metrics, maintenance windows and patch cadence, game days, and structured troubleshooting of an unknown outage. Not for metrics/logs/tracing tooling (devops-observability), backup/restore and DR mechanics (devops-storage-backup), pipeline implementation (devops-cicd), security incident response (fuse-security:security-expert) or FinOps.
